findings.description: Three hardcoded hex values (#D4A820 gold, #9CA3AF silver, #CD7F32 bronze) in getRankIcon function (lines 37-39) won't adapt to dark mode. Replace with CSS variables: var(--gold-dark) for first place, add --silver and --bronze to globals.css or use var(--ink-muted) for 2nd/3rd place.
Hardcoded #92600A color for instructor badge text (line 228). This color doesn't exist in the CSS variable system. Replace with var(--warning-text) or define a --gold-text variable in globals.css.
Two instances of hardcoded #DC2626 for notification count badges (lines 158, 252). Replace with var(--error-text) which adapts to dark mode (#DC2626 in light, #FCA5A5 in dark).

Multiple hardcoded colors in gradient backgrounds and trend indicators: #10B981/#059669 (green gradients), #2563EB/#1D4ED8 (blue gradients), #F59E0B (warning text). Lines 116-117, 133, 143, 168, 183, 193, 251, 353-355. Either add --success and --info gradient pairs to globals.css or use existing var(--navy)/var(--gold) gradients.
Chart components receive hardcoded color props (line 251: color="#10B981" for AreaChart). Replace with CSS variables so charts adapt to dark mode.

Trend indicator icons use hardcoded colors: #10B981 for revenue/user growth, #F59E0B for class count (lines 116-117, 143, 168). Replace #10B981 with var(--success-text) and #F59E0B with var(--warning-text).
Recent activity avatar backgrounds use hardcoded gradient colors (#10B981/#059669, #2563EB/#1D4ED8) mixed with CSS variables (lines 353-355). Use semantic CSS variables for all gradient states.

DataTable component not used — each content component implements custom table/card layouts. This is architecturally inconsistent but functionally correct. If DataTable reuse is desired, the component needs enhancement for custom cell renderers and expandable rows.
